//: Single source of truth for the capability-probe script (scripts/preflight.sh) and the per-platform generator (harness-gen). Edit this file, not their output. See AGENTS.md.

project.name: Harbour
project.//name: Display name shown to an agent/operator. This is the template's own demo brand (see artifacts/web/content/settings/footer.yml). An adopter forking this template for a real client replaces it with the client's name.

site.//host: This template's own demo deployment — an adopter replaces it with the client's origin, same as project.name above. Whatever it says here, the value that actually builds the sitemap is the NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL environment variable (see .env.example at the repo root): artifacts/web/src/app/sitemap.ts falls back to https://example.com when that is unset, and ships a sitemap of example.com URLs without failing the build. Set both, and set them to the same origin. Documentation only: not read by scripts/harness-gen or scripts/preflight.sh.

commands.//dev: Consumed: interpolated verbatim into the generated .replit's "run" line by scripts/harness-gen/adapters/replit.ts.
commands.//build: Documentation only: not read by scripts/harness-gen or scripts/preflight.sh. Recorded here for an operator/agent scanning this file for the build command.
commands.//check: The whole gate, as one command. It used to be an eight-entry restatement of the individual checks, which is how it came to be missing brand:check: a hand-maintained copy of a list that grows. .github/workflows/ci.yml now runs this same script rather than its own steps, so there is exactly one list and it lives in package.json. Documentation only: not read by scripts/harness-gen or scripts/preflight.sh.

//platforms: Consumed: drives which harness-gen adapters run (scripts/harness-gen/index.ts). Each entry must match a key in that file's ADAPTERS map (currently "replit", "claude-code") — an unrecognized entry fails generation with a named error instead of silently doing nothing.

capabilities.label: Newsletter Block form submissions post to a Slack channel
capabilities.fallback: -> Point the Newsletter Block's `action` prop (artifacts/web/src/lib/blocks/schemas.ts, artifacts/web/src/components/blocks/newsletter.tsx) at a different form endpoint you do control (e.g. Formspree, a serverless function), or leave `action` as a placeholder URL until a real endpoint is configured. The Block itself has no server code — `action` is a plain literal URL prop, so any safe-scheme endpoint works.

capabilities.label: Image uploads to Vercel Blob storage
capabilities.fallback: -> Reference existing images by URL instead of uploading new ones: images.unsplash.com, assets.ui.sh, or a file already committed under artifacts/web/public/ (served as a relative /path). These are the only hosts artifacts/web/next.config.mjs's images.remotePatterns allows besides *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com, and mediaSrc() in schemas.ts enforces the same list at build time.
